  charL.position.x=-0.60-kv(TR.shiftL,t);
  headL.rotation.set(kv(TR.headLx,t),kv(TR.headLy,t),0);
  eyesL.position.set(kv(TR.eyeLx,t),kv(TR.eyeLy,t),0);
  const sL=kv(TR.eyeLs,t);
  eyeLL.scale.set(0.10*esL*sL,0.145*esL*sL,0.055*esL*sL);
  eyeLR.scale.set(0.10*esL*sL,0.145*esL*sL,0.055*esL*sL);
  smileLm.scale.setScalar(Math.max(kv(TR.smileL,t),0.001));
  const oL=Math.max(kv(TR.openL,t)*(0.9+0.1*talkL),0.001);
  openLm.scale.set(oL,oL*1.3,oL*0.55);
  /* belly bulge + jiggle synced to the pat stroke */
  const k=kv(TR.bellyK,t);
  bellyL.scale.set(0.74*(1+k+0.012*pat2),0.66*(1+0.8*k+0.012*pat2),0.34*(1+1.2*k-0.03*down));
  /* writing scribble (pen rides on hand, hand rides on arm) */
  armLW.rotation.set(0.03*scrib,0.06*scrib,0);

  /* right character: lean in + pat + talk */
  charR.rotation.set(0.06+0.01*pat2,-0.40,0.16+0.03*down);
  charR.position.x=0.62-0.02*down;
  headR.rotation.set(0.05+0.035*nod,0.15,-0.06+0.03*down);
  const sR=kv(TR.eyeRs,t);
  eyeRL.scale.set(0.10*esR,0.145*esR*sR,0.055*esR);
  eyeRR.scale.set(0.10*esR,0.145*esR*sR,0.055*esR);
  smileRm.scale.setScalar(Math.max(kv(TR.smileR,t),0.001));
  const oR=Math.max(kv(TR.openR,t)*(0.9+0.1*talkR),0.001);
  openRm.scale.set(oR,oR*1.25,oR*0.55);
  /* patting arm swings about shoulder; fingers curl on press */
  armRP.rotation.set(0.20*down,0.05*pat,-0.04*down);
  if(fingersRP) fingersRP.rotation.x=0.15*down;

  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}

window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras:{ref}, characters, render, ready:true };
render(0);
</script>
